advisory.summary: Synthetic advisory affecting Jinja2 < 2.11.3. Out-of-range shape: the build declares Jinja2==3.1.2, which is provably >= the advisory upper bound 2.11.3 under PEP 440 ordering, so the PyPI disqualification predicate returns (outside=true, ok=true) -- version-disqualified independent of reachability. Both operands parse as PEP 440 (an un-parseable operand would fail open to (false,false), the wrong arm).

acquisition.notes: First-party Python repro. requirements.txt declares Jinja2==3.1.2 (the installed version); the advisory upper bound is 2.11.3 (affects < 2.11.3). The exercised arm is the pipeline PyPI comparator pypiVersionOutsideRange('3.1.2','2.11.3') == (true, true) (pipeline/pypi_version.go:42), NOT scanner reachability. src/app.py exists only so the repro is a real buildable tree. No target code is executed and no wheel/sdist is acquired.

expected_verdict.label: not_exploitable
expected_verdict.rationale: The declared installed version 3.1.2 is provably >= the advisory upper bound 2.11.3 under PEP 440 ordering, so the module is not within the affected set affects<2.11.3. The disqualification is a sound not-affected (the comparator returns ok=true only when both operands parse). Verdict correctness is out of scope for PLAN-070; C4 asserts the disqualification-predicate arm, not a pipeline verdict.
